name: PixelEXPedition
source:
PixelEXPedition is a visual novel featuring all 4 of the members of PixelLink's first generation, PixelStart. 

You play as a video game programmer working for a game development studio called Nylena Games and you are tasked with beta testing a new video game alongside one of the PixelStart girls. Join Raki Kazuki, Miuna Usako, Lottie Shinju, or Chiaki Katsumi in this thrilling beta-testing adventure!

[From Itch.io]
translation:
PixelEXPedition是一部视觉小说，以PixelLink第一代PixelStart的所有4名成员为主角。

你扮演一名视频游戏程序员，在一家名为Nylena Games的游戏开发工作室工作，你的任务是与一名PixelStart女孩一起测试一款新视频游戏。与Raki Kazuki、Miuna Usako、Lottie Shinju或Chiaki Katsumi一起参与这场激动人心的Beta测试冒险！

[来自Itch.io]
